meta.title: PR 123: Add queued report delivery
meta.head: feature/queued-report-delivery
meta.author: example-author
meta.intent: Queue completed reports for durable delivery while preserving retry and tenant boundaries.

overview: This change moves report delivery out of the request path and into a durable queue. The API now records a delivery request, the worker claims queued items, and the storage layer tracks attempts and terminal outcomes.
The primary review path is the lifecycle contract: one tenant must not claim another tenant's report, retries must remain bounded, and completed deliveries must not be processed again.

files.change: Replaces synchronous delivery with queue submission and returns an accepted response.
files.interactions: Calls ReportDeliveryService and maps service results to HTTP responses.
files.evidence: Changed handler and response contract at lines 42-71.

files.role: Coordinates queue submission and worker claims.
files.change: Adds idempotent enqueue, claim, success, and retry transitions.
files.interactions: Uses DeliveryRepository and the existing mail provider adapter.

files.change: Adds tenant scope, attempt count, status, and delivery timestamps.
files.interactions: Persisted by DeliveryRepository and created by the migration.
files.evidence: New model and status constraint at lines 9-58.

files.role: Exercises the delivery lifecycle against the test database.
files.change: Covers idempotency, tenant isolation, retry limits, and terminal claims.
files.interactions: Drives the route and worker through the real repository contract.

layers.title: Accept the Delivery Request
layers.purpose: Translate an authenticated HTTP request into a durable delivery command.

layers.title: Queue and Claim Delivery Work

layers.changed_behavior: Workers now claim one eligible delivery atomically and record provider outcomes.
layers.contract: Receives tenant-scoped commands and emits repository transitions plus provider calls.
layers.interaction: Coordinates the delivery repository and existing mail provider adapter.

snippets.code:
delivery = await self.repository.claim_next(
    tenant_id=tenant_id,
    eligible_statuses={"queued", "retryable"},
)
if delivery is None:
    return None
await self.provider.send(delivery.payload)

class ReportDeliveryRecord(SQLModel, table=True):
    tenant_id: UUID = Field(index=True)
    report_id: UUID
    idempotency_key: str
    status: str = Field(default="queued", index=True)
    attempt_count: int = 0
